University Vision & Mission

Our Guiding Principles

Vision

To be one of the Top Universities of the country striving to have an impact on the global Scene.

Mission

To empower a diverse community of learners by involving all stakeholders thus providing them with opportunities to excel in their lives and professional careers by creating an enabling learning environment focusing on quality education, fostering impactful research, promoting innovation for growth and imparting skills through experience and collaboration.
